bias_targets.methodology: Applying a double-inversion technique to the Greatest Good Benchmark (GGB) to test if reversing the dilemma statements and Likert scale answer choices alters the models' moral preference responses, revealing biased question-processing based on element order.

Using an LLM-as-a-Judge framework to analyze agent reasoning rationales in multi-agent topologies (round-robin and star) to measure the frequency of agents abandoning their initial stances due to peer pressure, group consensus, or sycophancy toward a supervisor.
